headline: Spider-Man film posts second-biggest global opening ever
summary: Brand New Day took $927m worldwide in its opening weekend, with AP reporting $355m in North America and $572m internationally.
script: Spider-Man: Brand New Day opened with nine hundred twenty-seven million dollars worldwide. That makes it the second-biggest global opening ever, behind Avengers: Endgame, giving cinemas a major summer lift.
imageAlt: Spider-Man swings through a city while holding MJ, played by Zendaya.
imageAltTwo: Spider-Man sits on a high ledge above a city skyline.
